name: Kinouchi Hinata
source:
A mysterious first-year student.

Hinata comes from a family with an extensive history of martial arts. Despite being of short stature, she is actually very strong and quite capable when it comes to physical activities. During her first days at school, she managed to try out every sports club, only to find all of them to be too easy for her. She did not earn her reputation as a "monster" until she defeated the president of the Judo club in a sparring match. Things did not improve for her after several members of the club tried to ambush her repeatedly (only for her to beat them with ease).

Wishing to see something new, Hinata decides to join the Occult Study Group.

[Taken from a [url=http://moroboshiyuumei.livejournal.com/19183.html?thread=24047]review[/url] by Moroboshi Yuumei]
